## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List the relevant checks actually run and their results. Explain any unrun checks.

- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or failures/unrun checks are explained.
- [ ] Visual changes include real rendered frames and a readability check, when applicable.
- [ ] Shared schema, both backends and knowledge guides agree, when affected.
- [ ] Upload ZIP is refreshed if its bundled source or README changed.
- [ ] Attribution and external licenses are retained; no secrets or private artifacts are included.
